Class SpatialTensorComparisonPane

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
org.ether.society.ui.analytics.SpatialTensorComparisonPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class SpatialTensorComparisonPane extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
2D Spatial Tensor invalid input: '&' Cartographic Comparison Pane.

Provides side-by-side raster visualization, discrepancy heatmapping \(\Delta(A - B)\), chronological timeline scrubbing with interactive playback, multi-channel physical and cliodynamic tensor analysis, and spatial fidelity metrics (SSIM, RMSE, Pearson \(r\), Jaccard index, and Kullback-Leibler divergence).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
